name: Pebble Frame
description: A frame that holds a picture in a smooth pebble outline which drifts slowly, pulls round on hover and wobbles like jelly when pressed.

props.name: children
props.description: What the pebble holds: an image, a video, an avatar, or a link or button around one. Direct children are stretched to fill the frame, and images and videos are cropped to cover it. Put a link or button inside the frame rather than around it, so its focus ring can follow the outline.

props.name: seed
props.description: Picks the pebble's shape and the course of its drift. Frames with different seeds drift independently. The first frame, rendered on the server, already has this shape.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How far from a circle the outline wanders, from 0 (a circle) to 1 (long, uneven stones). The outline stays smooth and convex at every value.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the drift. At 1 the stone changes character over about 12 seconds; 0 holds the current shape while hover and press still respond.

props.name: ring
props.description: Draws the outline as a hairline over the picture. It takes `color` on hover and focus.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Hover and keyboard focus pull the outline into a circle that swells by 3% while the picture sinks by 4%; a press squashes it toward the pointer and it rings on release. Off, the frame only drifts. Keyboard focus on a child always shows a ring along the outline.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Adds a soft ground shadow under the stone that follows its lowest edge.

props.name: color
props.description: The colour the `ring` hairline turns on hover and focus.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame. It is a square 192px wide by default; set a width (it keeps its square shape) or a size of your own. In a frame that is not square the outline stretches with it, and hover pulls it into the inscribed oval.
